LA Downtown Medical Center in Los Angeles, CA, has been using Azalea Health as their EHR since February 2019 and implemented the system within five months. Multiple sources confirm that LA Downtown Medical Center in Los Angeles, CA, utilizes Azalea Health as their EHR system, highlighting its benefits and impact since implementation in 2019.

Yes, LA Downtown Medical Center (LADMC) in Los Angeles, CA, uses Azalea Health as their electronic health record (EHR) system.

Here’s what the search results indicate:

  • Selection of Azalea Health: In February 2019, LADMC selected Azalea Health as their EHR to manage acute care patient workflows across multiple departments.
  • Implementation: LADMC implemented the Azalea EHR platform in under five months.
  • Benefits: LADMC has leveraged the Azalea Health EHR to manage multiple workflows and bridge behavioral health with other inpatient and outpatient services. The hospital has also relied on Azalea Health to meet the increased demand for behavioral health services related to the COVID-19 pandemic.
  • Executive Testimony: Vicki Rollins, an executive at LADMC, stated that they chose Azalea Health’s EHR because it is easy to implement and adapt, lightweight, and straightforward to integrate with other technologies. She also noted the ability to configure the EHR for multiple workflows without complex coding changes.
  • CMS Rating: LADMC is one of only two hospitals in Los Angeles to receive a five-star rating from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services in January 2020, supported by the Azalea EHR.
  • Employee Training: LA Downtown Medical Center provides Azalea Training Videos for their employees.

Yes, LA Downtown Medical Center (LADMC) in Los Angeles, CA, utilizes Azalea Health as their Electronic Health Record (EHR) system. Here’s the evidence:

  • Case Study & Testimonials: Multiple sources refer to a case study about L.A. Downtown Medical Center (LADMC) and Azalea Health. These sources highlight how LADMC chose Azalea Health’s EHR in 2019 due to its ease of implementation, adaptability, and ability to integrate with other technologies.
  • Improved Outcomes: LADMC’s IT administration lead, Dilip Niranjana Jay, is quoted in several articles discussing the benefits of the Azalea Health EHR. These benefits include scalability, flexibility, and support for clinical quality excellence. Jay stated that LADMC experienced a 24% increase in revenue, a 25% increase in beds, and a 77% increase in patient volumes within a year after implementing Azalea Health.
  • Five-Star CMS Rating: LADMC is mentioned as being one of only two hospitals in Los Angeles to receive a five-star rating from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services in January 2020, which was supported by the Azalea EHR.
  • COVID-19 Support: During the COVID-19 pandemic, LADMC leveraged Azalea’s customizable workflows to adapt to changing patient needs. They also built a COVID interface with Azalea Health to meet state reporting requirements.
  • Employee Training: The LA Downtown Medical Center’s website has a section for employees that mentions “Azalea Training Videos” for their electronic health record.
  • Specific Features: Reports indicate that Azalea Health offered LADMC an EHR that could be configured by workflow, provider type, and patient population without requiring coding changes or IT involvement. 80% of a clinician’s work could be done from one screen.
  • Cloud-Based System: The EHR’s cloud backbone provides scalability, enabling staff to support growth and adjust to changing patient volumes.
